[[File:Grand_Piazza.png|thumb|right|250px|The Grand Piazza]]
The '''Grand Piazza''' was part of the [[Anaxes Citadel]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Anaxes/Legends|Anaxes]]. In its center lay a forty meter band of blue flagstones, surrounded by walkways of golden serpentine flooring, around which lay the [[Colonnades]]. Only those ranking [[Captain/Legends|captain]] or higher were allowed on the golden stones, and only those personally decorated within the Piazza could walk on the blue stones.<ref name="CatCW">''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]''</ref>
